title: VCPS approval record (checkpoint decision or pre-authorization)
description: Structural schema for .vcps/approvals/HCR-*.md and .vcps/approvals/PREAUTH-*.md frontmatter. Owned in content by standard/human-checkpoints.md SS3-4 (VCPS-HC-020, VCPS-HC-030/031). NEW_CANONICAL_RECONSTRUCTION authored 2026-10-06; see evaluation/completion-roadmap.md Phase B.

checkpoint_codes.description: VCPS-HC-002: every applicable checkpoint, not only the first recognized.

human_actor.description: VCPS-HC-021: only a human actor may record a decision or pre-authorization. An agent identity here is invalid.

action.description: The exact action being decided/authorized (VCPS-HC-010/VCPS-HC-004 scope binding).

scope.description: The exact scope this decision/authorization covers. Required for both kinds.

revision.description: Revision this decision is bound to, where applicable (VCPS-HC-004). Null only when the checkpoint is not revision-specific.

decision.description: Required when kind is DECISION. Never set by an agent (VCPS-HC-021).

conditions.description: Required, non-empty, when decision is APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS.

max_impact.description: Required when kind is PRE_AUTHORIZATION (VCPS-HC-030): the recorded maximum impact bound.

reuse_permission.description: What matching future actions this pre-authorization covers without a fresh synchronous decision.

deferral_follow_up.description: workflows/hotfix.md VCPS-WF-HOTFIX-001: for an HC-16 gate-requirement deferral, the follow-up commitment (owner + deadline) that MUST be recorded alongside it. Not schema-required here (checking 'checkpoint_codes contains HC-16' is beyond this repository's JSON Schema subset validator's keyword support) -- its absence on an HC-16 decision is instead flagged by adapters/claude-code/lib/vcps_evidence.py's lapsed-deferral-check as a candidate issue. Per VCPS-WF-HOTFIX-003, a lapsed (deadline-passed) deferral is not tracked here as 'resolved' by editing this record (AG-011 forbids editing a decision record to misstate what happened) -- resolution is a separate, later record; this field only ever records the original commitment.

items.description: VCPS-HC-031: pre-authorization MUST NOT cover HC-04 (on protected branches -- not structurally distinguishable here, see note below), HC-06, HC-08, HC-10, HC-14, or HC-16 under any circumstance.
